structured.approach:
I read the requirement-steps procedure for REQ-05 and the two contracted inputs, the approved feat.brd and org.templates. I also read the source ticket file to confirm wording; the BRD already cites it. I then drafted feat.prd against the PRD template: summary, user stories, numbered acceptance criteria in EARS form, non-functional requirements and open questions. The PRD carries the BRD's scope, business rules, success measures, out-of-scope items, assumptions and open questions forward without adding scope. It also has a BRD-to-PRD traceability table and a validation check against the template, the BRD, the decision log and the approved lessons. An independent verifier subagent checked the draft. It found that AC-2 silently decided BRD question OQ-B6 (an unpaid row that has a paid_date) and that a few statements were unlabelled extrapolations. I fixed all of these:
- AC-2 now covers paid rows only.
- The "So that" clauses are marked as agent judgement.
- The end-to-end match criterion is now assumption P-A4.
- The PQ-1 and PQ-3 wording no longer goes beyond the sources.

claims.text: The PRD template requires summary, user stories, numbered acceptance criteria in EARS form (When <trigger>, the system shall <response>), non-functional requirements and open questions; feat.prd has all five sections.
The approved BRD scopes seven items S-1 to S-7 across ap_pipeline, ap_forecast, ap_aging and ap_portal, and the PRD maps each to user stories and acceptance criteria without adding scope.
Vendor risk is 'high' when predict_delay_days(history) > 30, 'medium' when > 10, otherwise 'low'; the thresholds are strict, so exactly 30 is 'medium' and exactly 10 is 'low' (AC-7 to AC-9).
The overdue list includes only unpaid invoices more than 30 days past due; an invoice exactly 30 days past due is not listed, and this boundary is tested explicitly (AC-14, NFR-8).
Overdue rows carry id, vendor, days, amount and risk, are sorted by days descending then id, and get risk 'unknown' when the vendor is not in risk_by_vendor (AC-16, AC-17).
An invalid paid_date rejects the feed row with reason 'paid_date' (AC-3).
Amounts are Decimal with 2 dp, never float, and travel between services as strings with two decimals; dates travel as ISO strings (AC-18, NFR-1, NFR-2).
The feed schedule stays daily 02:00 Asia/Kolkata; ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_aging are Python 3.9 and ap_portal is Node.js 22 CommonJS (NFR-9, NFR-10).
The PRD was checked against decisions D-2026-031, D-2026-044 and D-2026-050 and found no conflict; lessons L-007 and L-011 are applied.
BRD open questions OQ-B1 to OQ-B10 and assumptions B-A1 to B-A7 are carried forward; OQ-B6 is kept open by limiting AC-2 to paid rows.
This step is triggered by BRD approval; owner and gate are PM.

open_questions: PQ-1: What should vendor_risk return for an empty history? The inputs do not say how predict_delay_days behaves on an empty list, or whether a vendor with no paid history gets an entry in risk_by_vendor.

PQ-2: Confirm the PRD assumptions P-A1 to P-A4: days in an overdue row is counted from due_date to as_of; the id tie-break is ascending and compares ids as text; an invalid paid_date is non-empty and not a valid ISO date; the end-to-end test checks that the rendered table matches the overdue list.
PQ-3: Should the overdue list between ap_aging and ap_portal have a named JSON contract, including the type of days? Proposed for the TRD (REQ-07).
PQ-4: No performance, data volume or availability targets are given.
PQ-5: Who orders this change and PROV-ACME-2026-11? Both change build_explanation_request.
PQ-6: Is feed v3 available for CR-1? ZD-48470 brings feed v2.

Carried from the BRD, still open: OQ-B1 to OQ-B10. Notable among them: OQ-B6 (an unpaid row that has a paid_date), OQ-B8 (HTML escaping), OQ-B9 (whether the risk is shown as visible text) and OQ-B10 (how ap_portal formats the amount without using float).
structured.summary:
I wrote feat.prd for FEAT-ZD-48600. It carries the approved BRD forward and adds no scope:
- Five user stories.
- 23 numbered EARS acceptance criteria covering the paid_date feed column, delays_by_vendor, vendor_risk thresholds, the optional risk argument on build_explanation_request, overdue_with_risk, renderOverdueRisk and the end-to-end flow. Boundary cases at exactly 30 days and at risk thresholds 30 and 10 are explicit.
- Twelve non-functional requirements: Decimal handling, JSON amounts as two-decimal strings, unchanged signatures, the advisory-only risk label, no LLM for the risk level, security scope, testability, schedule and runtimes.
- BRD assumptions and open questions carried forward, plus four new assumptions (P-A1 to P-A4) and six new non-blocking questions (PQ-1 to PQ-6).
- A traceability table and a validation check, which found no conflict with the decision log or the BRD.

A verifier pass found one silent resolution of BRD question OQ-B6 and some unlabelled extrapolations; all are fixed. The PRD is ready for the PM gate.
